app.title: Claim Autopsy
app.tagline: Find out why a BPJS claim came back.
app.synthetic: All data is synthetic. Rules are a simplified subset for demo, not official BPJS rules.

report.heading: Autopsy report
report.empty: Pick a returned claim, then run the autopsy.
report.degraded: The live model was unavailable. This report uses saved model results.
report.noCause: No cause found. The claim passed every check.

drawer.simplified: Simplified for demo. Not an official tariff or BPJS rule.
drawer.deterministic: Deterministic rule. The same input always gives the same result.
drawer.modelNote: Found by the language model. Its quote was checked against the summary word for word.

R_LOS.title: Length of stay in group range
R_LOS.desc: Counts the days between admit and discharge and compares them with the range allowed for the INA-CBG group. A same-day stay counts as 1 day.

R_DATES.title: Valid admit and discharge dates
R_DATES.desc: Checks that both dates are real dates and that discharge is not before admit.

R_PRIMARY_DX.title: Primary diagnosis fits the group
R_PRIMARY_DX.desc: Checks that the primary diagnosis code belongs to the diagnoses the INA-CBG group covers, and that the group code is known.

R_PROC_SUPPORT.title: Procedure has a supporting diagnosis
R_PROC_SUPPORT.desc: Checks that a coded procedure is backed by at least one diagnosis on the claim that justifies it.

R_CODE_FORMAT.title: Code format
R_CODE_FORMAT.desc: Checks that diagnosis and procedure codes have the shape of ICD-10 and ICD-9-CM codes.

M_UNCODED_DX.title: Diagnosis in the summary but not coded
M_UNCODED_DX.desc: The language model looks for a diagnosis the discharge summary states that the claim does not code.

M_DATE_MISMATCH.title: Summary disagrees on dates
M_DATE_MISMATCH.desc: The language model looks for a stay length or discharge date in the summary that disagrees with the claim.

M_PROC_MISSING.title: Procedure in the summary but not coded
M_PROC_MISSING.desc: The language model looks for a procedure the summary describes that the claim does not code.

dates.inverted: The discharge date ({discharge}) is before the admit date ({admit}).
dates.invalid: The admit or discharge date is missing or is not a valid date.

los.out_of_range: The stay lasted {los} days, but the {group} group allows {min} to {max} days.

cbg.unknown: The INA-CBG code {cbg} is not in the rule data.

primary_dx.not_in_group: The primary diagnosis {code} does not belong to the {group} group ({cbg}).

procedure.unsupported: The procedure {procedure} ({label}) has no supporting diagnosis on the claim.

code.format: The code {code} does not look like a valid code.

resume.uncoded_dx: The discharge summary states a diagnosis that is not coded on the claim.
resume.date_mismatch: The discharge summary disagrees with the claim on the length of stay or the discharge date.
resume.proc_missing: The discharge summary describes a procedure that is not coded on the claim.

fix.correct_dates: Correct the admit and discharge dates so they match the medical record.
fix.review_los_or_regroup: Check the length of stay against the record. If it is right, add a justification or review the group.
fix.regroup_cbg: Regroup the claim from its primary diagnosis.
fix.align_procedure_and_dx: Make the procedure and the diagnoses agree: fix the procedure code or add the supporting diagnosis.
fix.correct_code: Correct the code so it has a valid format.
fix.add_missing_dx: Add the missing diagnosis code to the claim.

error.autopsy_failed: The autopsy could not be completed. Please try again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
